fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Germany follows Schengen rules, so your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Alemania sigue las normas Schengen, por lo que el pasaporte debe caducar al menos 3 meses después del día en que piense salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: You can travel without a visa to the Schengen area, including Germany, for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
entry.es: Se puede viajar sin visado al espacio Schengen, incluida Alemania, hasta 90 días en cualquier periodo de 180 días.
entry.quote: You can travel without a visa to the Schengen area, which includes Germany, for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.

entry.en: At German border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket and prove you have enough money for your stay.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo alemán puede que deba mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación y demostrar que tiene dinero suficiente para su estancia.
entry.quote: At German border control, you may need to: - show a return or onward ticket - prove that you have enough money for your stay

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area for short stays you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo, at no cost.
entry.es: Al entrar en el espacio Schengen para estancias cortas puede que deba registrar datos biométricos, como huellas y una foto, sin coste.
entry.quote: you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo. There is no cost for EES registration.

entry.en: A temporary reintroduction of border controls is currently in place at Germany's land borders.
entry.es: Actualmente hay controles fronterizos temporales en las fronteras terrestres de Alemania.
entry.quote: A temporary reintroduction of border controls is currently in place at Germany’s land borders.

entry.en: You must declare any amount above 10,000 euros in cash or other payment types when taking money into Germany.
entry.es: Al llevar dinero a Alemania debe declarar cualquier cantidad superior a 10.000 euros en efectivo u otros medios de pago.
entry.quote: You must declare any amount above 10,000 euros in cash or other payment types.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Germany.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Alemania.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Germany.

safety.en: Crime levels are similar to the UK, but you should take sensible precautions against mugging, bag-snatching and pickpocketing.
safety.es: Los niveles de delincuencia son similares a los del Reino Unido, pero conviene tomar precauciones contra atracos, tirones de bolso y carteristas.
safety.quote: Crime levels are similar to the UK. Take sensible precautions to avoid mugging, bag-snatching and pickpocketing.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties, even when transiting through the airport.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, conllevan penas severas, incluso en tránsito por el aeropuerto.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.

safety.en: Only change money at banks, ATMs or official exchanges, because British nationals have been arrested for trying to pay with counterfeit currency.
safety.es: Cambie dinero solo en bancos, cajeros u oficinas oficiales, ya que ciudadanos británicos han sido detenidos por intentar pagar con moneda falsa.
safety.quote: Only change money at banks, ATMs or official money exchanges. Check your change when paying in cash. British nationals have been arrested for trying to pay with counterfeit currency.

safety.en: Off-piste skiing is very dangerous and can invalidate your travel insurance.
safety.es: Esquiar fuera de pista es muy peligroso y puede invalidar el seguro de viaje.
safety.quote: Off-piste skiing is very dangerous and can invalidate your travel insurance.

safety.en: Pickpockets may sometimes be an issue in large cities or at events with large crowds.
safety.es: Los carteristas a veces pueden ser un problema en las grandes ciudades o en eventos con mucha gente.
safety.quote: Pickpockets may sometimes be an issue in large cities or at events with large crowds.

health.en: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Germany you need a GHIC or EHIC, which is not an alternative to travel insurance.
health.es: Para recibir la atención sanitaria pública médicamente necesaria en Alemania se necesita una GHIC o EHIC, que no sustituye al seguro de viaje.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Germany, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: Tap water is of excellent quality and can be consumed with little concern.
health.es: El agua del grifo es de excelente calidad y se puede beber sin demasiada preocupación.
health.quote: Tap water (Leitungswasser) is of excellent quality, and can be consumed with little concern.

health.en: Pharmacies are called Apotheke and are marked by a big, red A symbol.
health.es: Las farmacias se llaman Apotheke y se reconocen por una gran A roja.
health.quote: Pharmacies are called "Apotheke" (compare the older English word, "apothecary") and are marked by a big, red "A" symbol.

health.en: Antibiotics and some other drugs that are freely available in other countries need a prescription in Germany.
health.es: Los antibióticos y algunos otros medicamentos de libre venta en otros países requieren receta en Alemania.
health.quote: Antibiotics and some other drugs that are freely available in other countries need a prescription in Germany.

health.en: Foreign insurance may not be accepted by local hospitals, and German health care is expensive.
health.es: Es posible que los hospitales locales no acepten seguros extranjeros, y la atención sanitaria alemana es cara.
health.quote: Foreign insurance, even if it covers travel abroad, may not be accepted by local hospitals.

health.en: The emergency medical number is 112, and you should ask for an ambulance.
health.es: El número de emergencias médicas es el 112; hay que pedir una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: In Germany the emergency number for ambulance and fire is 112 and for police is 110.
help.es: En Alemania el número de emergencias para ambulancia y bomberos es el 112 y para la policía el 110.

help.en: FCDO can be called in London on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours, for urgent help about a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres al 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas, si un amigo o familiar necesita ayuda urgente en el extranjero.

help.en: The emergency numbers 112 and 110 can be dialled toll-free from any phone.
help.es: Los números de emergencia 112 y 110 se pueden marcar gratis desde cualquier teléfono.
help.quote: These numbers can be dialled toll-free from any phone, including phone booths and mobile phones (SIM-card required).

getting_in.en: The most important airports are Frankfurt, Munich and Berlin.
getting_in.es: Los aeropuertos más importantes son Fráncfort, Múnich y Berlín.
getting_in.quote: The most important airports are Frankfurt (FRA IATA), Munich (MUC IATA) and Berlin (BER IATA).

getting_in.en: Germany is a member of the Schengen Agreement.
getting_in.es: Alemania es miembro del Acuerdo de Schengen.
getting_in.quote: Germany is a member of the Schengen Agreement.

getting_in.en: As of 2026, German border police regularly conduct border checks with all nine neighbouring countries.
getting_in.es: En 2026, la policía fronteriza alemana realiza controles regulares en la frontera con los nueve países vecinos.
getting_in.quote: as of 2026, officers of the German border police regularly conduct border checks with all of its nine neighbouring countries

getting_in.en: Düsseldorf, Cologne, Hamburg and Stuttgart also have many international flights.
getting_in.es: Düsseldorf, Colonia, Hamburgo y Stuttgart también tienen muchos vuelos internacionales.
getting_in.quote: Düsseldorf (DUS IATA), Cologne (CGN IATA), Hamburg (HAM IATA) and Stuttgart (STR IATA) also have many international flights.

getting_around.en: The Deutschlandticket covers all regional trains and local public transport throughout Germany for a calendar month and cost €58 as of January 2025.
getting_around.es: El Deutschlandticket cubre todos los trenes regionales y el transporte local de toda Alemania durante un mes natural y costaba 58 € en enero de 2025.
getting_around.quote: With the Deutschlandticket you can ride all regional trains and the local public transport throughout Germany. The ticket costs €58 (Jan 2025) and can be used for a whole calendar month.

getting_around.en: The text says Deutsche Bahn's on-time performance is considered abysmal, with long delays and cancellations expected.
getting_around.es: El texto indica que la puntualidad de Deutsche Bahn se considera pésima y que cabe esperar largos retrasos y cancelaciones.
getting_around.quote: expect long delays, cancellations and the very real prospect of being stranded in the middle of nowhere. Deutsche Bahn's on-time and operational performance are considered abysmal.

getting_around.en: If a long-distance train is cancelled or delayed more than 20 minutes at your departure station, you can take any other train to your destination.
getting_around.es: Si un tren de larga distancia se cancela o se retrasa más de 20 minutos en su estación de salida, puede tomar cualquier otro tren a su destino.
getting_around.quote: if a long-distance train is cancelled or delayed more than 20 min at your departure station, you can simply take any other train connection to your final destination

getting_around.en: Tickets booked in advance, at the earliest 180 days before departure, can be surprisingly affordable.
getting_around.es: Los billetes reservados con antelación, como pronto 180 días antes de la salida, pueden ser sorprendentemente asequibles.
getting_around.quote: If you book tickets in advance (180 days before departure at the earliest) it can be surprisingly affordable.

getting_around.en: Germany has a network of Autobahn motorways with no toll for cars, and traffic drives on the right.
getting_around.es: Alemania tiene una red de autopistas Autobahn sin peaje para coches, y se conduce por la derecha.
getting_around.quote: Germany has a world-famous network of excellent roads and Autobahn (motorways) with no toll or fees for cars.

getting_around.en: Uber, Bolt, Free Now and Sixt Ride are available in several German cities, are expensive and often only accept cash.
getting_around.es: Uber, Bolt, Free Now y Sixt Ride están disponibles en varias ciudades alemanas, son caros y a menudo solo aceptan efectivo.
getting_around.quote: Uber, Bolt, Free Now and Sixt Ride are available in several German cities.   They are expensive and often only accept cash.

money.en: Germany uses the euro, whose ISO code is EUR.
money.es: Alemania usa el euro, cuyo código ISO es EUR.
money.quote: Germany uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: Independent vendors, small cafes and Christmas Market stalls may not accept cards.
money.es: Los vendedores independientes, los cafés pequeños y los puestos de los mercados navideños pueden no aceptar tarjetas.
money.quote: independent vendors, small cafes and stalls in the likes of Christmas Markets may not accept cards

money.en: These ATMs usually charge high convenience fees, often €4 to €5.
money.es: Estos cajeros suelen cobrar comisiones altas, a menudo de 4 a 5 €.
money.quote: These machines are often found in tourist hotspots and usually charge high convenience fees (often €4–€5)

money.en: All goods and services include VAT of 19%, which is always included in the price tag.
money.es: Todos los bienes y servicios incluyen un IVA del 19 %, siempre incluido en la etiqueta del precio.
money.quote: All goods and services include VAT (Mehrwertsteuer) of 19%. The tax is always included by law in an item's price tag.

money.en: Tips are commonplace in restaurants, bars, taxis and hair salons; they are not mandatory but appreciated.
money.es: Las propinas son habituales en restaurantes, bares, taxis y peluquerías; no son obligatorias pero se agradecen.
money.quote: tips (Trinkgeld, literally "drink(ing) money") are commonplace in restaurants (except fast-food ones), bars, taxis and hair salons.

money.en: Small shops and even a few automated public transport machines do not accept €50 or larger banknotes.
money.es: Las tiendas pequeñas y algunas máquinas de transporte público no aceptan billetes de 50 € o más.
money.quote: Small shops and even a few automated machines for public transport do not accept €50 or larger banknotes.

etiquette.en: Germans value honesty and straight talking, and tend to communicate tactfully and respectfully.
etiquette.es: Los alemanes valoran la honestidad y hablar claro, y suelen comunicarse con tacto y respeto.
etiquette.quote: Germans are direct communicators and rarely hesitate to state their thoughts. This said, they tend to communicate their thoughts tactfully and respectfully.

etiquette.en: Using the surname and the formal pronoun Sie is seen as a sign of friendly respect, and being too formal is virtually always the safer option.
etiquette.es: Usar el apellido y el pronombre formal Sie se considera una muestra de respeto amistoso, y ser demasiado formal es casi siempre lo más seguro.
etiquette.quote: being too formal by using "Sie" is virtually always the "safer" option

etiquette.en: Saying Du to a police officer on duty can even get you fined.
etiquette.es: Tutear con Du a un policía en servicio incluso puede acarrear una multa.
etiquette.quote: saying "Du" to a police officer on duty can even get you fined

etiquette.en: Smoking tends to be forbidden anywhere inside unless explicitly allowed, and the laws are strictly enforced.
etiquette.es: Por lo general está prohibido fumar en interiores salvo que se permita expresamente, y las leyes se aplican estrictamente.
etiquette.quote: smoking tends to be forbidden anywhere inside unless explicitly allowed, and allowed outside unless explicitly forbidden. The laws are strictly enforced.

etiquette.en: In most saunas nudity is compulsory and mixed sessions are common.
etiquette.es: En la mayoría de las saunas la desnudez es obligatoria y las sesiones mixtas son habituales.
etiquette.quote: In most saunas, nudity is compulsory and mixed sessions are common practice.

connectivity.en: Mobile coverage on the three networks (Deutsche Telekom, Vodafone and O2) is by and large excellent throughout the country.
connectivity.es: La cobertura móvil de las tres redes (Deutsche Telekom, Vodafone y O2) es en general excelente en todo el país.
connectivity.quote: Mobile phone coverage on the three networks (Deutsche Telekom, Vodafone, and O2) is by and large excellent throughout the country.

connectivity.en: The law requires registration when purchasing a prepaid SIM card.
connectivity.es: La ley exige registrarse al comprar una tarjeta SIM de prepago.
connectivity.quote: The law requires registration when purchasing a prepaid SIM card.

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi is common in Germany, usually free within the premises but sometimes requiring a purchase.
connectivity.es: El wifi es habitual en Alemania, normalmente gratuito en el local pero a veces requiere hacer una compra.
connectivity.quote: Usually it's free within the premises but sometimes requires a purchase.
